reviews.title: Hudl has gotten absolutely terrible
reviews.text:
Hudl has gotten absolutely terrible. For how expensive this service is, it’s ridiculous that the app can’t even reliably play an entire game anymore.

Games constantly stop loading halfway through. Then I have to completely close the app, reopen it, find the game again, and hope I remember exactly where I left off. That is beyond frustrating when I’m trying to watch film and actually get work done.

The old version worked better. Somehow every “improvement” has made the experience worse. Even Classic Mode doesn’t work properly anymore, so there isn’t even a reliable fallback.

At this point, stop trying to reinvent the app and make the basic features work again. I don’t need a prettier interface. I need to be able to watch a full game without the app freezing, losing my place, or forcing me to restart.

For what Hudl charges teams and programs, this level of performance is unacceptable. Fix the app and bring back the reliability it used to have.

reviews.title: Terrible interface, unreliable, slow.
reviews.text: This app is the worst. Constantly has buffering issues, it turns perfectly good videos fuzzy in Hudl, it claims there are video quality issues even when recorded in 4K, it cuts videos short for no reason, and during busy times, it’s impossible to upload new content. It took over 12 hours to upload 1 video, and then couldn’t upload any others (3 days after the tournament ended). It constantly forces the user to sign back in. This feedback is consistent across everyone on our sports team who is forced to use Hudl. They have over-promised and continue to under-deliver. The Android app is 10 times worse. Not the way to run a business.

Other issue is when mirroring and working with more than one app.  When you toggle between apps, the screen goes full white.
